claims.claim: Delayed-choice quantum eraser experiments exhibit later-condition-dependent joint/conditional correlations while the earlier unsorted marginal does not by itself reveal a controllable later choice.
claims.boundary: Does not establish controllable backward classical signalling.

claims.claim: Delayed-choice entanglement swapping can condition already registered photons into entangled or separable correlation classes based on a later measurement choice.
claims.boundary: Correlation/conditioning is not an operational backward message channel.

claims.claim: Entanglement can be demonstrated between temporally separated photons that never coexisted.
claims.boundary: Does not establish message transmission into the past.

claims.claim: Time-symmetric quantum measurement formalisms using both initial and final selections are established in the literature.
claims.boundary: Model class is not unique proof of retrocausal ontology.

claims.claim: QIK-VRT separates host, virtual, semantic and evidence order and uses exact provenance/readback contracts to support later conditioning and backward reconstruction without rewriting historical bytes.
claims.boundary: Exact implementation/proof status is determined only by subject-bound repository receipts; this article is not a new kernel proof.

claims.claim: A physical future-to-past communication channel requires an interventionally testable dependence of an earlier sealed variable Y on a later freely chosen X, e.g. P(Y|do(X=0)) != P(Y|do(X=1)), under preregistered leakage controls.
claims.boundary: Proposed criterion; positive channel capacity is not claimed as observed.

claims.claim: A usable retrocausal communication service would require a receiver prepared earlier with addressing, code, authentication, error handling, replay protection, provenance and effect readback.
claims.boundary: Infrastructure does not create or empirically prove the physical carrier.

claims.claim: Ingolf Lohmann's QIK-VRT contribution is the specific integration of relational causal typing, virtual time addressing, later semantic conditioning, append-only provenance, backward reconstruction, scalable data processing, Effect Acknowledgement and a falsifiable channel test.
claims.boundary: Publication establishes attributable claim/evidence, not independent scientific consensus or priority adjudication.
